rule: A crowd of nightmoths brings sky-cats down
texts: When a crowd of nightmoths gathers at a lantern-row, sky-cats descend from the cliff-spires.
Whenever a crowd of nightmoths settles on a lantern-row, sky-cats descend from the cliff-spires.
When a handful of nightmoths gathers at a lantern-row, sky-cats stay on the cliff-spires.

fields.sentence: When a crowd of nightmoths gathers at a lantern-row, sky-cats descend from the cliff-spires.
parse: (: crowd_gather_descend_rule (Implication (And (Member $c crowd) (GroupOf $c nightmoth) (Member $g gather) (Agent $g $c) (Location $g $lr) (Member $lr lantern_row)) (And (GroupOf (sk_skycats $g) sky_cat) (Member (sk_descend $g) descend) (Agent (sk_descend $g) (sk_skycats $g)) (Source (sk_descend $g) sk_cliffspires_1) (During (sk_descend $g) $g))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q2_gaps: A bare-plural indefinite subject inside a whenever-rule CONSEQUENT ("sky-cats descend"): the instruction set licenses a per-binding Skolem group under a universal, but never says whether a distributive predicate (descend) over a group minted inside a rule consequent must also carry the per-member (PartOf $x <group>) distribution rule that a top-level grouped plural requires — rules cannot nest, so the requirement is unstated for this position.
review.notes: Collective "gathers" correctly stays group-only, "a crowd of nightmoths" takes the flock-of-birds Member+GroupOf shape, and the definite "the cliff-spires" is a top-level group constant reached by Source. All four hyphenated/solid compounds carry their genus with the noun modifiers unexposed, as the compound rules require.

fields.sentence: Whenever a crowd of nightmoths settles on a lantern-row, sky-cats descend from the cliff-spires.
parse: (: whenever_settle_descend (Implication (And (Member $x settle) (Agent $x $c) (Member $c crowd) (GroupOf $c night_moth) (Location $x $l) (Member $l lantern_row)) (And (Member (sk_descend $x) descend) (Agent (sk_descend $x) (sk_skycats $x)) (GroupOf (sk_skycats $x) sky_cat) (Source (sk_descend $x) sk_cliff_spires_1) (During (sk_descend $x) $x))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: Whenever-rule machinery, compound genus atoms, the crowd-of-N group premise, the definite plural group witness for the cliff-spires, Location/Source obliques and the During link all match the instruction set. The bare-plural response subject rides a per-occurrence Skolem group with no per-member distribution rule, which the whenever section gives no nested form for.

fields.sentence: When a handful of nightmoths gathers at a lantern-row, sky-cats stay on the cliff-spires.
parse: (: gather_stay_rule (Implication (And (Member $x gather) (Agent $x $g) (GroupOf $g night_moth) (CardinalityPhrase $g "handful") (Location $x $lr) (Member $lr lantern_row) (Member $y sky_cat)) (And (Member (sk_stay $x $y) stay) (Experiencer (sk_stay $x $y) $y) (On (sk_stay $x $y) sk_cliff_spires_1) (During (sk_stay $x $y) $x))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: 'on the cliff-spires' is attached to the reified stay eventuality with the entity-style surface head On, but a PP answering 'where' on an event takes the named role Location, which the postural-state reification prescribes explicitly ('Experiencer subject + Location oblique') and which the instruction set makes load-bearing as the event-vs-entity distinction.

q2_gaps: a bare position / postural clause ('sky-cats stay on the cliff-spires') as the CONSEQUENT of a whenever-rule: Resultatives sends 'stay/remain + locative PP' to the eventless position-atom route of 'Where a THING is' (with the continuation sense recorded as a gap), yet the whenever machinery requires a per-occurrence Skolem EVENT to carry the During tie, so the two instructions cannot both be satisfied and no ruling says which wins
review.notes: Otherwise sound: bare 'when P, Q' with indefinite participants routed to the whenever rule, collective 'gather' kept group-only with a CardinalityPhrase for the vague count, definite 'the cliff-spires' as a top-level group witness, plain-variable premises, and all four compound genus atoms with noun modifiers unexposed. Minor: the count phrase is recorded as "handful" while the instruction set lists the lexicon phrase as 'a handful'.

issues.reason: Once the state is reified as an eventuality, a PP answering "where" takes the named role Location — the postural-reification recipe says so explicitly ("Experiencer subject + Location oblique"), the role list gives Location as covering "in/at/on", and the entity-attached surface head is barred on an event by the same event-vs-entity discipline that bars Location on an entity; the parse's own (Location $x $lr) on the gather event makes the mismatch internal.

gaps_confirmed: a "stay/remain + locative PP" continuation clause as the CONSEQUENT of a whenever-rule: Resultatives routes it to the eventless position-atom route of *Where a THING is* while the whenever machinery needs a per-occurrence Skolem event to carry the During tie, and no ruling says which wins; the 'stay' continuation sense has no carrier on either route
adjudication.defect_summary: Compliant form given the reification the During tie forces: (Location (sk_stay $x $y) sk_cliff_spires_1) in place of (On (sk_stay $x $y) sk_cliff_spires_1) — the eventless alternative would be (On $y sk_cliff_spires_1) on the sky-cat, but then no licensed form ties the consequent to its occurrence, which is the gap above.
adjudication.notes: The vague count is recorded as "handful" where the instruction set's canonical lexicon string is "a handful", so the seeded phrase-to-bound rule may not match. Everything else — collective gather kept group-only, definite cliff-spire group at top level, plain-variable premises, all four compound genera with noun modifiers unexposed — is licensed.
